vvb_guidance.mass_uncertainty_search_note: Doc read in full; no section defines a per-weighing mass uncertainty other than the standard 72.57 kg convention, and no method is published that would yield 290.98 kg.

sampling_mechanism.kb_protocol: Charm's quality-control sampling protocol collects a jar sample at each transfer event, every transfer, and sends composites to SGS for full characterisation.
sampling_mechanism.applied_here: The four transfer events for this batch are the four offloads weighed 7-08 to 7-10. The certificate records SAMPLE SOURCE 'Submitted Sample' and SAMPLED BY 'Client', i.e. a client-made-up composite rather than a lab-drawn sample, so the 22-Jul-2026 SAMPLED stamp is the date the weekly composite was made up and submitted, not a date on which oil was drawn from the injected stream.

protocol.section_4_0_scope_quote: Under this Module, the use of Book and Claim Units (BCUs) for low-carbon fuels to substitute for some, or all, of project fuel usage is permitted.
protocol.ec1_quote: BCUs must be purchased and retired by the Project Proponent in a volume equivalent to the volume of fuel substitution claimed.
protocol.ec1_documentation_quote: Provide proof of BCU purchase and retirement in a volume equivalent to the volume of fuel substitution claimed.
protocol.equation5_cap_quote: When applying Equation 4, at maximum, an amount of BCUs may be used for each journey, j, such that: (F_j - F_BCU,j x ED_BCU,j / ED_Fuel,Transportation,j) >= 0
protocol.embodied_not_bcu_eligible_basis: Section 4.0 and Equation 5 both scope BCUs to fuel usage (F_j) for a transportation journey. Vehicle embodied emissions are not fuel usage, so they fall outside the substitution the module permits.
